verdict.rationale: Docs confirm full/incremental backups and point-in-time restore capability (cockroachdb-docs-6, -15, -30), which supports the 'restores are self-serve' half of the story, but there is no evidence of a visible, configurable backup schedule/dashboard that a founder could see and adjust. A community report also notes backup/restore was historically gated behind an enterprise license, undercutting the 'self-serve' framing for non-enterprise users (cockroachdb-comm-8). Missing for 10: documentation of a schedule UI/CLI showing backup cadence, evidence of self-serve schedule configuration, and confirmation that this isn't enterprise-gated for the target persona.
